description: Hand-labelled, fictional passages for benchmarking zapper scorers against the sample lens (zapper/lenses/sample-lens.json): interests local-first software +0.9, school cybersecurity +0.8, data privacy +0.6, celebrity gossip -0.5. Labels: keep = on the reader's lens; zap = off it; evidence = a correction or primary-source citation, which must never be zapped. Several passages are deliberately hard: on-topic without the topic's words, or off-topic while using them.

passages.label: keep
passages.text: The Riverside Unified School District said its student information system is back online, three weeks after a ransomware attack forced teachers to take attendance on paper.

passages.label: keep
passages.text: According to the district, the attackers entered through a vendor account that lacked multi-factor authentication, and the investigation into whether records were copied is continuing.

passages.label: keep
passages.text: Middle school students in the county will run phishing drills this spring, learning to spot fake password-reset emails before an attacker sends a real one.

passages.label: keep
passages.text: The state is offering grants to help small districts hire their first full-time security officer and move their backups offline.

passages.label: keep
passages.text: Parents asked which student data the learning app collects, who it is shared with, and how long it is kept after a child leaves the district.

passages.label: keep
passages.text: A new state law requires apps aimed at children to let families download and delete everything the company holds about them.

passages.label: keep

passages.label: keep
passages.text: The farm cooperative's inventory app now works in barns with no signal, merging every phone's changes when it reconnects, with no central server required.

passages.label: keep
passages.text: CRDTs let two people edit the same document offline and converge on the same result later, which is why a growing number of note-taking apps keep your data on your own device first.

passages.label: keep
passages.text: The library's catalogue app was rebuilt to sync peer to peer between branches, so a network outage no longer stops checkouts.
